Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    line_col = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    left = min(c for r, c in obj)
    right = max(c for r, c in obj)
    stripe = left - 1 if line_col > right else right + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2),
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))

           if grid[r][c] not in (2, bg)]
    lo, hi = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    col = hi + 1 if hi < divider else lo - 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][col] = 8
    return out
```
